playstyle: A simple, solid all-rounder. Good generic pokes, strong punishment and great combo damage, plus stance mix-ups through Dynamic Entry (DEN), Silent Entry (SEN) and Limited Entry (LEN). Wavu notes his counter-hit game is below average apart from 1,1,1, so win by punishing and by stance pressure, not by fishing.

stances.name: Dynamic Entry
stances.note: DEN.1+2 is i12 and tornadoes; DEN.1,2 and DEN.3 are Heat Engagers; DEN.3 is +5 on block.

stances.name: Silent Entry
stances.entry: df+2, f+2,1 and others transition here; also used with ~f in combos
stances.note: SEN.1 is an i12 Heat Engager; SEN.2 is a low; SEN.4 is a homing high, +4 on block; SEN.1+2 is a power crush that tornadoes.

stances.name: Limited Entry
stances.note: A low-profile stance; LEN.2 tornadoes. Heat empowers LEN moves (Wavu).
